definitions.explanation: The foremost position in a line, group, or race; the front or leading position.

examples.japanese: ⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{先頭|せんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}んだ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧。
examples.english: I lined up at the front of the line.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{先頭|せんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{走|はし}って→走る：00519_hashiru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He is running in the lead.

examples.japanese: {先頭|せんとう}⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: I got on the front car (of the train).
examples.notes: 先頭車両 = front car/lead car

notes:
{先頭|せんとう} refers to being at the front or in the lead, whether physically in a line, in a race, or figuratively in leadership.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {先頭|せんとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at the front, to lead
- {先頭|せんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧: to take the lead, to be the first
- {先頭|せんとう}⟦{集団|しゅうだん}→集団：03211_shuudan⟧: leading group (in a race)
- {先頭|せんとう}⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧: front car (of a train)
- {先頭|せんとう}⟦{打者|だしゃ}→打者：06564_dasha⟧: leadoff batter (baseball)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{最後尾|さいこうび}→最後尾：21693_saikoubi⟧: rear, end of line
- ⟦{後方|こうほう}→後方：19126_kouhou⟧: behind, in the rear
